content.text:
Apple, Palantir, Pfizer, Marvell, AMD, Bloom Energy, Gartner, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
Stocks were mostly higher Tuesday as shares of tech companies were advancing and investors awaited U.S. midterm election results and another slate of earnings.
